saw_lines: Equipment buyers in a hurry want three answers first: the price, the shipping, and whether the box arrives intact.
So the sale is lost in the first line, before a buyer ever clicks through to the shipping page.
Your site offers 5% off with code REFRIG5, yet none of your 6 live ads mention it. Put it in the first line of three new ads and on the creative.
ads_1: Lead paid creative with the 5% off offer and a clear shipping answer
